CustomField.description: Blended "New Score" (0-100): (Own Score x Own_Score_Weight__c) + (avg of relationship-weighted sub-supplier contributions x Sub_Supplier_Weight__c), computed bottom-up (Tier 3 first) by MultiTierRollupService. Distinct from Risk_Score__c (own score only) and from Cascading_Risk_Tier__c (worst-case severity bucket, a separate signal).
